questions.q: In which year did Uganda become independent from Britain?
questions.why: Independence Day is 9 October.

questions.q: Which military dictator ruled Uganda from 1971 to 1979?
questions.why: He expelled Uganda's Asian community in 1972.

questions.q: Who has been President of Uganda since 1986?
questions.why: He came to power after a bush war.

questions.q: Which kingdom gives Uganda its name?
questions.why: Its king is called the Kabaka.

questions.q: What was the 1976 Israeli raid that freed hostages at Entebbe airport called?
questions.why: Almost all the hostages were rescued.

questions.q: Who was Uganda's first Prime Minister?
questions.why: He was later President twice.

questions.q: What is the title of the king of Buganda?
questions.why: His palace, the Lubiri, is in Kampala.

questions.q: Which explorer identified Lake Victoria as the source of the Nile in 1862?
questions.why: He named the outflow Ripon Falls.

questions.q: Which young Christians killed in 1885–87 are honoured as saints?
questions.why: Their shrine at Namugongo draws millions.

questions.q: Who was Uganda's first President, in 1963?
questions.why: He was also the Kabaka of Buganda.

questions.q: Which country's army helped overthrow Idi Amin in 1979?
questions.why: Amin had invaded Tanzania first.

questions.q: Which prehistoric-looking bird lives in Uganda's swamps?
questions.why: It has a huge shoe-shaped bill.

questions.q: Which UNESCO-listed tombs in Kampala hold the kings of Buganda?
questions.why: They were rebuilt after a fire in 2010.

questions.q: What is the capital of Uganda?
questions.why: It was built on seven hills.

questions.q: Which town is called the 'source of the Nile'?
questions.why: White-water rafting is popular there.

questions.q: Which lake does Uganda share with Kenya and Tanzania?
questions.why: It is Africa's largest lake.

questions.q: Which mountains on the Congo border are called the 'Mountains of the Moon'?
questions.why: Their peaks have glaciers.

questions.q: Which falls force the Nile through a gorge just 7 m wide?
questions.why: They give their name to a national park.

questions.q: What is Uganda's highest peak?
questions.why: It is 5,109 m high.

questions.q: Which national park is famous for tree-climbing lions?
questions.why: They rest in fig trees in the Ishasha sector.

questions.q: Which Ugandan won the Olympic marathon in 2012?
questions.why: It was Uganda's first gold in 40 years.

questions.q: Who won Uganda's first Olympic gold, in the 400 m hurdles in 1972?
questions.why: He set a world record.

questions.q: Which Ugandan runner won Olympic 10,000 m gold in Paris 2024?
questions.why: He had won 5,000 m gold in Tokyo.

questions.q: Which Bugandan craft, made from tree bark, is on UNESCO's list?
questions.why: It is made from the mutuba tree.

questions.q: Which great apes is Bwindi Impenetrable Forest famous for?
questions.why: About half the world's mountain gorillas live there.

questions.q: Which bird is on Uganda's flag?
questions.why: It stands in a white disc.

questions.q: What is Uganda's currency?
questions.why: Its code is UGX.

questions.q: Which nickname did Winston Churchill give Uganda?
questions.why: He used it in 1908.

questions.q: What is a 'Rolex' in Uganda?
questions.a: A chapati rolled with an omelette
questions.why: The name comes from 'rolled eggs'.

questions.q: Which steamed green bananas are a Ugandan staple?
questions.why: They are often steamed in banana leaves.
